set.body:
Point 3 consumer implementation. Boundaries: Main.scala, AppCompiler.scala, ModelInput/CLI loading, edition/shared decoding; preserve platform I/O separation. Depends on local provider adoption. AT-05 plus the runtime half of AT-04.

Acceptance: one local Open workflow consumes producer-generated WOG and a second small synthetic source/recall/mapping bundle without rebuilding app.js; both reuse the same application binary. Preserve checked imported provenance, draft status, derivation gaps and optional-feature absence; remove fixture-only provenance assumptions from the imported path. A partial model remains inspectable with explicit unavailable capabilities. Validate every required byte/semantic join before rendering; no silent WOG fallback. A failed replacement load cannot relabel stale content as the new workspace. Keep content capability checks ahead of visible DOM, accessibility tree, tooltip, logs and exports. Local loading initiates no remote inference/network call.

Falsifiers: exchange two recalls sharing local IDs/titles, mutate a source checksum/sidecar, remove a required role, assign fixture authority to an imported draft, delay a stale load completion, or inject denied content. Browser tests must distinguish each from lawful missing optional features. Fixture content belongs to the producer artifacts, never copied into shell source.

Evidence: exact producer/consumer/Intaglio/grakern revisions, actual overrides distinguished from declared pins; compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS; existing shell smoke plus named M1 workflow tests. Preserve warnings as findings and make changed code warning-clean. Browser automation uses the project browser, ownership audits before/after, and closes owned processes. Add a discriminating failure injection for each new boundary. Preserve static no-JavaScript publication as a separate contract. Test names for new M1 courts are specifications until implemented; never claim them run from ticket creation.
set.title: [M1] Open checked source-recall bundles without rebuilding app.js
